name: Vivek Vishal
summary: Vivek is a software engineer who started at Juspay and moved into mobility with the team that became Namma Yatri. His work spans onboarding, reliable systems, and everyday transport experiences. At Asha Health, he worked on healthcare AI agents and clinic automation.
journey: Vivek started as an intern at Juspay in March 2022. As a core team member, he helped build the onboarding assistant, reducing onboarding time from two weeks to one week.
After moving into a full-time role, he focused on developer productivity, system reliability, and improvements to existing systems.
He then moved to the mobility team that became Namma Yatri, working across rental and intercity rides, ticketing, parcel delivery, and bus experiences.
At Asha Health, he worked as a Software Engineer (IC4), with February–September 2026 listed in his résumé, building healthcare AI agents and clinic automation.
experience: Asha Health — Software Engineer (IC4), February–September 2026 as listed in his résumé. Vivek built healthcare AI agents and clinic automation, including a voice-agent server and revenue analytics.

Namma Yatri — Vivek worked on rental and intercity features, backend protocols, the open data dashboard, ticketing, parcel delivery, bus tracking, GPS tracking, and bus ticketing. He says he built the Google Maps metro booking integration from scratch, with Namma Yatri providing the booking service.
Juspay — In his full-time role, Vivek worked on productivity, reliability, and system improvements.

Juspay internship — Starting in March 2022, Vivek was a core member of the onboarding assistant team and helped build the overall system, reducing onboarding from two weeks to one. He also contributed to related projects.
achievements: Vivek helped cut onboarding time from two weeks to one as a core member of Juspay’s onboarding assistant team.
He built the Google Maps metro booking integration from scratch, with Namma Yatri supplying the metro booking service.
He built the parcel delivery feature and contributed across rental, intercity, and bus experiences at Namma Yatri.
At Asha Health, Vivek built a voice AI agent server that handled 1,000+ customers per day for clinic front-desk automation.
projects: At Namma Yatri, Vivek worked across ride booking, ticketing, parcel delivery, and bus systems. Ask about one area to explore what he contributed.
skills: Languages: Java, C++, Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, SQL, and C. Frontend: React, React Native, JavaScript, and Webpack.
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, Django, REST APIs, and distributed systems. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, and NoSQL.
AI and agents: LLM integration, ReAct loops, LangGraph, Pipecat, tool calling, skill orchestration, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and observability.
Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Temporal, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, structured logging, and alerting.
education: B.Tech in Information Technology, National Institute of Science and Technology, August 2019–May 2023. CGPA: 8.2. Coursework included Data Structures, Algorithms, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Compiler Design.
contact: You can connect with Vivek on LinkedIn or explore his work on GitHub using the links below.
